# container.Viewport: prevent nested Viewport instances from overwriting document.body classes and theme

## Context & Problem Statement

In Portal Home E2E CI run `43727822062` (shard 3, jobs `132853556048` and `132885395596`, observed on unrelated outside PR `#21027` and surfaced via `@neo-opus-grace`'s defect note), `test/playwright/e2e/portal/HomeAudienceDoorsNL.spec.mjs:57` failed deterministically twice at line `156` (`scrollHomeToReference(..., 'home-audience-doors', doors.id)`):

- `AudienceDoors` (`#neo-container-12`) stayed latched at `rect.top = 58px` with `scroller.scrollTop = 842` for the final 8.1 seconds of the 10-second poll while `scrollerRect.top` was **`45px`** (`Math.abs(58 - 45) = 13 > 4`).
- Inspecting the Playwright CI trace (`1-trace.trace` + screencast frames) proves this is NOT a mere smooth-scroll timing issue, but a host `document.body` theme hijack triggered whenever an embedded `Neo.code.LivePreview` instantiates a subclass of `Neo.container.Viewport`:
  1. During the downward scroll from `AudienceDoors` to `AiToolchain` (`#neo-container-28`), `IntersectionObserver` hits `Portal.view.home.parts.Helix` (`threshold: 0.6` in `apps/portal/view/home/MainContainer.mjs:95-102`) and invokes `Helix#activate()` (`apps/portal/view/home/FeatureSection.mjs:111-121`), which schedules `await me.timeout(1000)` before switching its embedded `Neo.code.LivePreview` (`#neo-container-22`) to `activeView = 'preview'`.
  2. When that timer lands during the subsequent upward scroll back to `AudienceDoors`, `Neo.code.executor.Neo` runs `Helix.livePreviewCode` (`class MainView extends Viewport { static config = { className: 'Portal.view.MultiWindowHelix', showGitHubStarButton: false, theme: 'neo-theme-dark' } }`) via `container.add({module})` inside `#neo-container-22`.
  3. `Neo.container.Viewport#onConstructed()` (`src/container/Viewport.mjs:96-104`) unconditionally invokes `DomAccess.applyBodyCls({cls: ['neo-body-viewport'], windowId})` and `me.theme && me.syncBodyTheme()`, and `syncBodyTheme()` (`src/container/Viewport.mjs:134`) only checks `if (!me.applyBodyCls)`.
  4. Because `container.Base#createItem` (`src/container/Base.mjs:470`) assigns `{parentId: container.id, theme: ...}` rather than `parentId: 'document.body'`, the nested `LivePreview` `Viewport` calls `DomAccess.setBodyCls({add: ['neo-theme-dark'], remove: ['neo-theme-neo-dark', ...]})` on the host window's `document.body`.
  5. Flipping Portal's `document.body` from `neo-theme-neo-dark` to `neo-theme-dark` shrinks `Portal.view.HeaderToolbar` from `58px` to `45px` (moving `scrollerRect.top` from `58px` to `45px` and growing `#neo-container-1` hero `min-height: 100%` from `842px` to `855px` after Blink already latched the smooth scroll at `scrollTop = 842`).

Design authority: `src/container/Viewport.mjs:25-29` (`"Assuming that a Viewport is the top level view of your app, and you want to mount it right away."`), `src/container/Viewport.mjs:107-127` (`#18571` contract: a viewport that owns `neo-body-viewport` owns `document.body` theme synchronization), and `resources/scss/src/container/Viewport.scss:1-4` (`body > .neo-viewport`).

*(Contributor labels `good first issue` and `help wanted` are intentionally omitted because this defect actively flakes CI on unrelated PRs and is claimed for immediate fix by `@neo-gemini-julia`.)*

## Acceptance Criteria

- **AC-1:** `Neo.container.Viewport` only applies `'neo-body-viewport'` and publishes/resets `document.body` theme classes (`syncBodyTheme`) when it owns the root body surface (`Boolean(this.applyBodyCls && this.parentId === 'document.body')`), while keeping its own `.neo-viewport` component `theme` class intact when mounted inside a parent container (`parentId !== 'document.body'`).
- **AC-2:** Unit regression coverage in `test/playwright/unit/container/ViewportBodyTheme.spec.mjs` proves a `Viewport` added inside a `Neo.container.Base` (`parentId !== 'document.body'`) invokes neither `DomAccess.applyBodyCls` nor `DomAccess.setBodyCls` on construction, theme change, or reset, while preserving all 8 existing root-`Viewport` (`parentId === 'document.body'`) arms.
- **AC-3:** Whitebox E2E coverage in `test/playwright/e2e/portal/HomeAudienceDoorsNL.spec.mjs` deterministically exercises embedded `FeatureSection` `LivePreview` (`Helix`) activation (`theme: 'neo-theme-dark'`), verifies `document.body` retains `neo-theme-neo-dark` and stage alignment holds cleanly, and passes 5 consecutive runs (`--repeat-each=5`).

## Out of Scope

- Changing `LivePreview` popout child-window (`LivePreview.MainContainer`) behavior: its `app.mainView` has `parentId === 'document.body'` in the child window and continues owning that child window's `document.body` theme.
- Switching Portal's own `Helix` / `Colors` preview examples away from `Viewport`.
